note: Candidates from the MASAF register that did not ship this pass. Kept per the nothing-is-thrown-away rule.

leads.name: Cedar of Lebanon, Viale Roma / Scuola San Paolo
leads.why: Register sheet 36/G478/PG/10, girth 370cm/18.5m. Locality is given as a street (Viale Roma) paired with a nearby school (Scuola San Paolo), the same pattern as pgi_003's Porta Pesa cedar which sits on the public square rather than inside the school. Access is probably fine but not independently confirmed this pass, and no second source beyond the register was found for this specific tree (only the general 102-tree Comune census, which was not searchable by address). Ship once a second source or a direct access check is found.

leads.name: Aleppo Pine, Sodo degli Ebrei (Via San Girolamo)
leads.why: Register sheet 06/G478/PG/10, girth 487cm/28m, second-largest girth in the Perugia batch. Confirmed by a La Nazione regional survey as one of Umbria's named monumental trees, giving a second source, but Sodo degli Ebrei is a small residential hamlet 2.5km from the centre and no source confirms whether the pine stands on public or private ground there. Worth a direct address check before shipping; also 2.25km out, so it would sit outside the centro storico walk regardless.

leads.name: Downy Oak, Prepo - Strada del Gioco (larger)
leads.why: Register sheet 15/G478/PG/10, girth 430cm/21m. No independent source found this pass beyond the register; 2.8km from centre, near a second downy oak (below). Untouched by discovery this pass, just unresearched.

leads.name: Downy Oak, Prepo - Strada del Gioco (smaller)
leads.why: Register sheet 14/G478/PG/10, girth 422cm/22m, roughly 150m from the other Prepo oak above; likely folds into one entry with it if researched later. No independent source found this pass.

leads.name: Downy Oak, Strada dei Conservoni
leads.why: Register sheet 13/G478/PG/10, girth 427cm/20.5m, isolated at 4km from centre, not near any other candidate. No independent source found this pass. [RESOLVED 2026-08-31, delivered as pgi_011]

leads.name: Mediterranean Cypress, Ponte Felcino
leads.why: Register sheet 09/G478/PG/10, girth 547cm/30.5m, the largest girth in the whole Perugia batch, but 4.16km out in the Ponte Felcino suburb, isolated from every other candidate, and no independent source or access detail found this pass. [RESOLVED 2026-08-31, delivered as pgi_012]

leads.name: White Mulberry, Cenerente
leads.why: Register sheet 33/G478/PG/10, girth 327cm, only 4m tall (unusually short for the girth, worth sanity-checking the height figure). 4.54km out in Cenerente, isolated, no independent source found this pass.

blocked.name: Holm Oak, Complesso di Santa Giuliana (Via Baldassarre Orsini)
blocked.reason: Register sheet 35/G478/PG/10, girth 381cm/17.5m, standing in the cloister courtyard of the former Santa Giuliana monastery. The complex is now the Italian Army's Foreign Languages School (Scuola Lingue Estere dell'Esercito) and is explicitly described as 'not normally accessible to the public', opening only for occasional heritage events (Monumenti Aperti). Blocked under hard rule 10: restricted institutional grounds, not genuinely open to visitors.
